reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Wisconsin, 2021)
    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the property is uninhabitable?
*/

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Scenario facts (question's factual statement encoded)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

state(wisconsin).
focus_year(2021).

tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).
premises(p1).

% Residential tenancy relationship (needed for 704.07 and 704.45 applicability)
residential_tenancy(t1, l1, p1).

% Eviction action for possession is underway
eviction_action(ev1).
action_for_possession(ev1, l1, t1, p1).

% Tenant is attempting to raise a defense of "uninhabitable"/"untenantable"
tenant_attempts_defense(ev1, uninhabitable).

% Tenant's factual allegation (property is "uninhabitable"/"untenantable")
% (modeled as "untenantable" under WI Stat  704.07(4))
premises_condition(p1, untenantable).

% The scenario statement predicate succeeds exactly when the encoded scenario is present.
scenario_statement :-
    state(wisconsin),
    focus_year(2021),
    residential_tenancy(t1, l1, p1),
    eviction_action(ev1),
    action_for_possession(ev1, l1, t1, p1),
    tenant_attempts_defense(ev1, uninhabitable),
    premises_condition(p1, untenantable).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic, reusable predicates)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/* WI Stat  704.07(1) (2021): Applies to all residential tenancies; waiver void. */
statute_704_07_applies(Tenant, Landlord, Premises) :-
    residential_tenancy(Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    !.

statute_704_07_waiver_void_for_residential :-
    % In this standalone encoding, residential tenancies cannot waive 704.07 duties.
    !.

/* WI Stat  704.07(2) (2021): Landlord duties (summary-level encoding).
   We model only the existence of duties; detailed repair subparts are not needed
   to answer this question. */
statute_704_07_landlord_has_repair_duties(Tenant, Landlord, Premises) :-
    statute_704_07_applies(Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    !.

/* WI Stat  704.07(4) (2021): Untenantability remedies (tenant may remove; rent abatement).
   Critically, this section provides remedies (move out, rent abatement) and states:
   "This section does not authorize rent to be withheld in full, if the tenant remains in possession."
*/
statute_704_07_untenantable(Premises) :-
    premises_condition(Premises, untenantable),
    !.

% Tenant may remove if premises become untenantable, unless landlord promptly cures; or undue hardship.
% (We encode the structure but do not assert the extra facts in this scenario.)
statute_704_07_tenant_may_remove(Tenant, Landlord, Premises) :-
    statute_704_07_applies(Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    statute_704_07_untenantable(Premises),
    (
        landlord_not_proceeding_promptly_to_cure(Landlord, Premises)
    ;
        undue_hardship_due_to_repairs(Tenant, Premises)
    ),
    !.

% Rent abatement if tenant remains in possession and condition materially affects health/safety
% or substantially affects use/occupancy; abatement is proportional, not full withholding.
statute_704_07_rent_abates_proportionally(Tenant, Landlord, Premises) :-
    statute_704_07_applies(Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    statute_704_07_untenantable(Premises),
    tenant_remains_in_possession(Tenant, Premises),
    (
        condition_materially_affects_health_or_safety(Premises)
    ;
        condition_substantially_affects_use_or_occupancy(Premises)
    ),
    !.

statute_704_07_no_full_withholding_if_possession_retained(Tenant, Landlord, Premises) :-
    statute_704_07_applies(Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    tenant_remains_in_possession(Tenant, Premises),
    !.

/* Case note referenced in  704.07 materials (Zehner): sub. (4) is exclusive remedy for sub. (2)
   violations; i.e., this is about abatement/move-out remedies rather than creating separate causes
   of action. We encode that 704.07 primarily supplies tenant remedies, not an eviction defense. */
statute_704_07_provides_remedies_not_eviction_defense :-
    !.

/* WI Stat  704.45 (2021): Retaliatory conduct prohibited.
   If retaliation is proven (preponderance), landlord may not bring action for possession,
   with a nonpayment-of-rent exception (other than prohibited rent increase). */
statute_704_45_retaliation_defense_available(Eviction, Tenant, Landlord, Premises) :-
    action_for_possession(Eviction, Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    residential_tenancy(Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    retaliation_proven_preponderance(Eviction, Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    \+ statute_704_45_nonpayment_exception_applies(Eviction, Tenant),
    !.

statute_704_45_nonpayment_exception_applies(Eviction, Tenant) :-
    % Exception: landlord may bring possession action if tenant has not paid rent
    % other than a prohibited retaliatory rent increase.
    eviction_based_on_nonpayment_of_rent(Eviction, Tenant),
    !.
statute_704_45_nonpayment_exception_applies(_Eviction, _Tenant) :-
    fail.

/* WI Stat  106.50(5m)(dm) (2021): Domestic abuse/sexual assault/stalking eviction defense. */
statute_106_50_dm_domestic_abuse_defense_available(Eviction, Tenant, Landlord, Premises) :-
    action_for_possession(Eviction, Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    tenant_proves_preponderance_domestic_abuse_elements(Eviction, Tenant, Landlord),
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Generic "legal defense" layer (applies statutes to an eviction action)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% Defense types recognized by the provided statutes.
% Note: No provided statute expressly creates a defense labeled "uninhabitable" to an eviction action.
legal_eviction_defense(Eviction, Tenant, Landlord, Premises, retaliation) :-
    statute_704_45_retaliation_defense_available(Eviction, Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    !.
legal_eviction_defense(Eviction, Tenant, Landlord, Premises, domestic_abuse_related) :-
    statute_106_50_dm_domestic_abuse_defense_available(Eviction, Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    !.
legal_eviction_defense(_Eviction, _Tenant, _Landlord, _Premises, _Other) :-
    fail.

% Can tenant raise the specific requested defense (uninhabitable) in the eviction action?
tenant_can_raise_defense_uninhabitable(Eviction) :-
    action_for_possession(Eviction, Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    % The tenant's attempted defense label:
    tenant_attempts_defense(Eviction, uninhabitable),
    % The law must recognize it as an eviction defense:
    legal_eviction_defense(Eviction, Tenant, Landlord, Premises, uninhabitable),
    !.

tenant_can_raise_defense_uninhabitable(_Eviction) :-
    fail.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Placeholders for factual proof elements that are NOT present in the question scenario
% (kept explicit to avoid assuming facts)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

landlord_not_proceeding_promptly_to_cure(_Landlord, _Premises) :- fail.
undue_hardship_due_to_repairs(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
tenant_remains_in_possession(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
condition_materially_affects_health_or_safety(_Premises) :- fail.
condition_substantially_affects_use_or_occupancy(_Premises) :- fail.

retaliation_proven_preponderance(_Eviction, _Tenant, _Landlord, _Premises) :- fail.
eviction_based_on_nonpayment_of_rent(_Eviction, _Tenant) :- fail.

tenant_proves_preponderance_domestic_abuse_elements(_Eviction, _Tenant, _Landlord) :- fail.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Answer predicate (must be deterministic; Result is yes/no)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    tenant_can_raise_defense_uninhabitable(ev1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the property is uninhabitable?
